verdict.rationale: TruffleHog's own CLI has a `--fail` flag that can be combined with `--since-commit` to scan only new commits and return a failing exit code. However, the evidence shows this only in a pre-commit hook context, not in CI pipelines running on pull requests. A Docker image and pre-receive hooks are documented, but nothing describes an official CI integration or per-PR workflow. missing for 10: documented CI/pull-request integration (e.g., an official CI action or pipeline examples), explicit exit-code semantics documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of failing builds in CI.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can run scans in CI on every pull request and fail the build on new findings via exit codes

citations.quote: consider the pre-receive hook option which can block commits with secrets from being accepted
